purpose: Nine illustrated, inspectable memory collectibles for Chrono Crawler
textPolicy: All narrative inscriptions and letter copy are live DOM text. Generated images intentionally contain no required readable writing.
validation: Source illustrations visually inspected as generated; dimensions, PNG decode and SHA-256 checked locally. In-game browser rendering remains unverified because existing browser permission is denied.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production collectible illustration for Chrono Crawler, an intimate Dark Deco narrative game. Square 1024x1024 raster artwork, painterly gouache and fine ink, beautifully tactile restrained animation-art realism, not pixel art, not UI mockup. Top-down carefully composed single keepsake on a flat muted deep petrol-grey desktop, subtle soft contact shadows, evenly illuminated and clearly inspectable. Main object fills 85 percent of image, all edges inside canvas. Rich but quiet teal, burgundy, faded jade, off-white and small ochre accents. No glowing effects, no extra props except explicitly requested. No watermark, logos or captions. Text will be added by the game, so avoid any legible text, labels, numbers or pseudo-writing unless specifically requested. A slightly creased off-white sheet containing a sincere child's wax-crayon drawing: a fanciful art-deco city with a tram, exactly THREE large sunny circles across the sky in gold, pink and soft blue; at bottom a small dark-bob-haired girl in a mustard cardigan and teal dress holding hands with a taller bespectacled father in a pale coat. Uneven childlike crayon pressure, rainbow window boxes, visible paper fibers. The drawing is joyful and ordinary, not eerie. Straight overhead sheet aligned nearly square, no written words.
